description: This file defines the WorkWeekDao class responsible for data access operations related to WorkWeek entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to save a WorkWeek, retrieve a WorkWeek by ID, and determine if a given day is a non-working day according to the WorkWeek schedule.

classes.name: WorkWeekDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing WorkWeek entities, providing methods to save, retrieve, and evaluate non-working days.

methods.name: saveWorkWeek
methods.description: Persists a WorkWeek entity to the database and returns the persisted entity.

methods.name: getWorkWeekById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkWeek entity based on its unique identifier.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines whether a given date is a non-working day according to the WorkWeek schedule, considering full-day or half-day options.
